title: Fix 274
no_spec_change_rationale: No requirement covers how the example script fails; it is a test harness for the verify lane. Only the script, its test, a case and a changelog fragment change.
acceptance_criteria: When a chough or SpecSync command whose JSON examples/feature-bug-loop.sh reads with jq fails or is refused, such as chough bug update --status verified, the example stops at that command with a non-zero exit and that command's error, and runs no later step. No such command's output is piped straight into jq. A run whose commands all succeed passes as before.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes, and a delta is frozen at approval (this change has none). No other lesson or principle constrains it.
